def extract_pairs(abed, bbed, groups):
    """
    Called by fromgroups(), extract pairs specific to a pair of species.
    """
    # get the group numbers for the two species
    a_group = groups[abed.species]
    b_group = groups[bbed.species]

    # get the indices of the two species
    a_idx = np.where(abed.group == a_group)[0]
    b_idx = np.where(bbed.group == b_group)[0]

    # get the indices of the pairs
    pairs = np.intersect1d(a_idx, b_idx)

    # get the data for the pairs
    return abed.iloc[pairs], bbed.iloc[pairs]
